ruleName: Playing from outside the teeing area
group: Playing from outside the teeing area
title: Correcting a teeing area mistake
question: After realising you hit your tee shot from outside the teeing area in stroke play, what should you do to avoid being disqualified?

choices.text: Go to your ball and continue playing, no penalty.
Replay your shot from within the teeing area and add two penalty strokes.
Replay from anywhere you like with just a warning.
Ask your opponent for permission to keep playing from where you are.

explanation: You must replay your shot from within the teeing area and take two penalty strokes to avoid disqualification.
